Concurrently, native smart contract ecosystems outside EVM—specifically Stellar Soroban via Protocol 20 and Blend v2—are consolidating around roughly $147M to $150M in lending pool TVL. Meanwhile, institutional infrastructure players like Ripple and Visa are actively building onchain credit and prime access rails.
